part2.audioText: What time does the pharmacy close on weekends?
part2.explanation: What time 問時間，(A)「晚上六點」正確。(B) 回答地點，(C) 疑問詞問句不能用 Yes/No 回答。

part2.audioText: Who approved the budget for next quarter?
part2.explanation: Who 問人，(B)「財務總監批准的」正確。(A) 回答金額，(C) 回答時間。

part2.audioText: Should we take the train or drive to the conference?
optionAudioTexts: Let's take the train. Parking is expensive there.
part2.explanation: A or B 選擇疑問句，(A) 選擇搭火車並說明理由，正確。選擇疑問句不能用 Yes/No 回答。

part2.audioText: The new intern starts on Monday, doesn't she?
part2.explanation: 附加問句確認實習生週一到職，(C) 更正說「其實是週三」，正確。(A) 用 internal 混淆 intern。

part2.audioText: Why don't we order lunch from the new Italian restaurant?
optionAudioTexts: Good idea. I'll find their menu.
part2.explanation: Why don't we...? 是提議（不如我們…吧），(B)「好主意，我去找菜單」正確。這不是真的在問原因，(A) 錯誤。

part2.audioText: How many people have registered for the training session?
part2.explanation: How many 問數量，(A)「目前超過三十人」正確。(B) 回答價格，(C) 回答地點。

part2.audioText: Could you forward me the meeting agenda?
optionAudioTexts: Sure, I'll send it right away.
part2.explanation: Could you...? 請求幫忙，(B)「好，馬上寄給你」正確。(C) 用 forward 的另一個意思混淆。

part2.audioText: Where can I find the office supplies?
optionAudioTexts: In the cabinet next to the copier.
part2.explanation: Where 問地點，(C)「影印機旁的櫃子裡」正確。(A) 用 supplies/surprisingly 音近混淆。

script: W: Good morning, this is Emily from TechServe. I'm calling about the laptop you sent in for repair.
M: Oh yes, the one with the cracked screen. Is it ready?
W: The screen has been replaced, but our technician also noticed your battery is quite worn. It only holds about half of its original charge.
M: I see. How much would a new battery cost?
W: Normally it's ninety dollars, but since you're already paying for a repair, we can offer it for seventy, including installation.
M: That sounds reasonable. Please go ahead, and I'll pick everything up on Friday afternoon.

options: To give an update on a repair
questions.explanation: 女子開頭說 I'm calling about the laptop you sent in for repair，來電告知維修進度，故選 (B)。

questions.q: What problem does the woman mention about the battery?
options: It holds only half of its original charge.
questions.explanation: 女子說電池 only holds about half of its original charge（只能存原本一半的電量），故選 (C)。

questions.q: What will the man do on Friday?
questions.explanation: 男子最後說 I'll pick everything up on Friday afternoon（週五下午去取件），故選 (D)。

script: M: Hi, Rachel. Have you seen the results of the customer satisfaction survey we ran last month?
W: I just finished reading them. Overall the scores are good, but many customers complained about long waiting times on our support hotline.
M: Yes, I noticed that too. The average wait was almost twelve minutes. Maybe we should hire two more support agents.
W: That would help, but it takes time to train new people. In the meantime, we could add a call-back option so customers don't have to stay on the line.
M: Good idea. Could you prepare a short proposal for the department meeting on Thursday?
W: Sure. I'll have it ready by Wednesday afternoon so you can review it first.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
questions.explanation: 開頭就問 Have you seen the results of the customer satisfaction survey，兩人接著討論調查結果，故選 (A)。

questions.q: What did many customers complain about?
questions.explanation: 女子說 many customers complained about long waiting times on our support hotline（客服專線等太久），故選 (B)。
女子建議 we could add a call-back option（增加回撥服務），故選 (C)。

part4.script: Good afternoon, shoppers. Thank you for visiting Fresh Mart. This weekend only, we are celebrating our tenth anniversary with special discounts throughout the store. All fresh fruit and vegetables are twenty percent off, and imported cheese is buy one, get one free. In addition, customers who spend more than sixty dollars will receive a free reusable shopping bag at the checkout counter. Don't forget to download our mobile app, where you can find extra coupons and earn points with every purchase. Fresh Mart will close at eleven tonight, one hour later than usual. Thank you, and enjoy your shopping.

questions.explanation: we are celebrating our tenth anniversary，慶祝開店十週年，故選 (B)。

questions.q: How can customers receive a free shopping bag?
options: By spending more than sixty dollars
questions.explanation: customers who spend more than sixty dollars will receive a free reusable shopping bag，消費滿 60 元送購物袋，故選 (A)。

questions.q: What does the speaker say about tonight's closing time?
options: The store closes at the usual time.
The store closes one hour later than usual.
The store stays open all night.
questions.explanation: close at eleven tonight, one hour later than usual，今晚比平常晚一小時打烊，故選 (C)。

part4.script: Welcome, everyone, to the first day of our new employee orientation at Corestone Manufacturing. I'm Angela Ruiz, the human resources manager. This morning, we'll begin with a tour of the production facility, so please put on the safety helmets and vests provided at the back of this room. For safety reasons, photography is not allowed inside the facility. After the tour, we'll return here for lunch, which the company will provide. In the afternoon, you'll receive your employee ID badges and computer accounts. Please remember to bring a form of identification, such as a passport or driver's license, when you come back from lunch.

questions.q: Who most likely is the speaker?
options: A tour guide at a museum
questions.explanation: 說話者自我介紹 I'm Angela Ruiz, the human resources manager（人資經理），故選 (C)。

questions.q: What are listeners asked to wear during the tour?
questions.explanation: please put on the safety helmets and vests，參觀時須戴安全帽穿背心，故選 (B)。

questions.q: What should listeners bring in the afternoon?
questions.explanation: remember to bring a form of identification, such as a passport or driver's license，下午要帶身分證件，故選 (A)。

part5.q: The quarterly report must be reviewed by the supervisor ------- it is submitted to headquarters.
part5.explanation: 空格後是完整子句，需要連接詞 before（在…之前）。「報告送總部前必須先經主管審閱」。during/despite/toward 都是介系詞。

part5.q: Ticket holders are advised to arrive early, as seating is available on a first-come, first-served -------.
part5.explanation: on a first-come, first-served basis = 依先到先得的原則，固定用法，選名詞 basis。

part5.q: The CEO announced that profits ------- by nearly 12 percent in the second quarter.
part5.explanation: announced（過去式）之前已發生的成長，用過去完成式 had risen。announce that 後的內容早於宣布時間。

part5.q: ------- of the two proposals will be selected at Friday's board meeting.
part5.explanation: One of the two proposals = 兩個提案中的一個。Every 後接單數名詞不接 of the two，Much 用於不可數。

part5.q: The workshop was so ------- that many attendees asked for a follow-up session.
part5.explanation: so + 形容詞 + that 句型，修飾 workshop 用 informative（內容豐富的）。informed 指「消息靈通的（人）」。

part5.q: Passengers may bring one carry-on bag ------- it fits under the seat or in the overhead bin.
part5.explanation: as long as = 只要（條件）。「只要放得進座位下或行李櫃，可帶一件隨身行李」。

part5.q: Ms. Duval was promoted to regional manager in ------- of her outstanding sales performance.
part5.explanation: in recognition of = 以表彰…，固定片語，介系詞 in 後接名詞 recognition。

part5.q: The maintenance crew will inspect the air-conditioning units ------- Thursday morning.
part5.explanation: 特定日子（星期、日期）用介系詞 on。「維修人員將於週四早上檢查空調」。

part5.q: Staff members are encouraged to share ------- ideas during the brainstorming session.
part5.explanation: 修飾名詞 ideas 用所有格 their。「鼓勵員工在腦力激盪會議中分享他們的想法」。

part5.q: The hotel offers a complimentary shuttle service to guests ------- at the airport.
part5.explanation: guests arriving at the airport = 抵達機場的旅客，現在分詞當形容詞用（= who arrive）。

part5.q: Due to rising material costs, the company had no ------- but to increase its prices.
part5.explanation: have no choice but to V = 別無選擇只好…，固定用法。「因原料成本上漲，公司只好漲價」。

part5.q: The revised safety guidelines apply to ------- who enters the laboratory.
part5.explanation: anyone who... = 任何進入實驗室的人。「新版安全規範適用於所有進入實驗室者」。

part6.passage:
Dear Valued Customer,

Thank you for shopping with Lumen Electronics. We are writing to let you know that the wireless headphones you ordered have been [33] and are on their way to you. Your package is expected to arrive within three business days. You can track its progress at any time by [34] the tracking number below into our website. If your order does not arrive by August 8, please contact our customer service team. As a token of our appreciation, we have included a coupon for 10% off your next [35].

Sincerely,
Lumen Electronics

questions.explanation: 後文說 on their way to you（正在配送途中），可知商品已出貨，選 shipped。
介系詞 by 後接動名詞 V-ing，by entering the tracking number = 透過輸入追蹤碼。
電子產品商店的折價券用於「下次消費」，10% off your next purchase，選 purchase。

part6.passage:
MEMO
To: All Sales Staff
From: Karen Wu, Sales Director
Date: August 2
Re: Monthly Sales Meeting

Please note that this month's sales meeting has been moved from August 10 to August 12 [36] a scheduling conflict with the product launch event. The meeting will still be held in Conference Room C at 2:00 P.M. All team leaders are expected to [37] a five-minute summary of their region's performance. Slides should be sent to my assistant, Daniel, no later than August 11. Attendance is [38] for all sales staff; if you cannot attend, please inform your team leader in advance.

questions.explanation: 空格後是名詞片語 a scheduling conflict，用介系詞片語 due to（由於）。because 後須接子句。
be expected to + 原形動詞，present a summary = 報告摘要，選原形 present。
後句說不能出席要事先告知組長，可知出席是強制的，選 mandatory（必須參加的）。optional（自由參加）與語意相反。

part7.passage:
【Advertisement】
Swift Office Cleaning Services

Is your office too busy to keep clean? Let Swift take care of it! We have provided professional cleaning services to more than 300 companies in the metro area since 2015. Our services include daily trash removal, carpet cleaning, window washing, and restroom sanitation. All of our cleaning products are environmentally friendly and safe for use around office equipment.

We offer flexible scheduling: our teams can work early mornings, evenings, or weekends, so your business is never interrupted. Sign a twelve-month contract before August 31 and receive your first month of service at half price. For a free on-site estimate, call 555-0177 or visit www.swiftclean.com.

questions.explanation: 廣告開頭與內容都在介紹辦公室清潔服務（Swift Office Cleaning Services），故選 (B)。

questions.q: What is stated about the cleaning products?
questions.explanation: All of our cleaning products are environmentally friendly，清潔用品皆環保，故選 (C)。

questions.q: How can a customer receive a discount?
options: By signing a twelve-month contract before August 31
questions.explanation: Sign a twelve-month contract before August 31 and receive your first month at half price，8/31 前簽一年約首月半價，故選 (A)。

part7.passage:
【E-mail】
From: Marcus Reed <mreed@harborviewhotel.com>
To: Julia Fontaine <jfontaine@gmail.com>
Subject: Re: Reservation Change Request
Date: August 2

Dear Ms. Fontaine,

Thank you for contacting us about your reservation (confirmation number HV-88214). As requested, we have changed your check-in date from August 15 to August 17. Your check-out date remains August 20, so your stay is now three nights instead of five. The updated total is $540, and the difference of $360 will be refunded to your credit card within five business days.

Please note that your original booking included breakfast for two guests, and this has been kept in your updated reservation. However, the airport pickup you reserved for August 15 has been canceled. If you would like to arrange a pickup for August 17 instead, please reply to this e-mail with your flight details at least 48 hours before arrival.

We look forward to welcoming you.

Best regards,
Marcus Reed
Guest Services, Harborview Hotel

questions.q: Why did Mr. Reed send the e-mail?
options: To confirm a change to a reservation
To apologize for a billing error
questions.explanation: 信件回覆訂房變更請求並確認新的入住日期，故選 (A)。

questions.q: How many nights will Ms. Fontaine now stay at the hotel?
questions.explanation: your stay is now three nights instead of five，改為住三晚，故選 (B)。8/17 入住、8/20 退房。

questions.q: What was canceled from the original reservation?
questions.explanation: the airport pickup you reserved for August 15 has been canceled，原訂的機場接送已取消，故選 (B)。早餐仍保留。

questions.q: What is Ms. Fontaine asked to do if she wants a new pickup?
options: Send her flight details by e-mail
questions.explanation: please reply to this e-mail with your flight details at least 48 hours before arrival，需在抵達 48 小時前回信提供航班資訊，故選 (C)。
